current_task_binding.dataset_name: MOD15A2H.061 Terra Leaf Area Index/FPAR 8-Day Global 500m

spatial_coverage.coverage: Terrestrial areas within the national boundary of China, including croplands, forests, grasslands, wetlands, shrublands, and other vegetated surfaces.

analytical_capabilities: Quantifying canopy leaf area and absorbed photosynthetically active radiation
Tracking seasonal canopy development and deriving growing-season metrics from sub-monthly composites
Detecting long-term and interannual trends in canopy density
Comparing canopy structure across land-cover types, elevation belts and management regimes
Propagating retrieval uncertainty through analyses using the per-pixel standard deviation bands

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Leaf Area Index as one-sided leaf area per unit ground area (m2/m2); FPAR as the fraction of incident photosynthetically active radiation absorbed by the canopy
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Apply the scale factors: multiply `Lai_500m` and `LaiStdDev_500m` by 0.1, and `Fpar_500m` and `FparStdDev_500m` by 0.01. Stored values run 0 to 100, so scaled LAI reaches 10 m2/m2 and scaled FPAR reaches 1.0; values above 100 are fill and must be masked before any reduction. Screen retrievals with `FparLai_QC` and `FparExtra_QC` before analysis: the main algorithm retrieval is the highest-quality class, while backup-algorithm and saturated retrievals are common over dense canopies and over snow, cloud and aerosol contamination. `LaiStdDev_500m` and `FparStdDev_500m` give the per-pixel retrieval spread and flag cells where the estimate is weakly constrained. This is a Terra-only collection on an 8-day step; the Aqua counterpart MYD15A2H shares the grid and cadence from 2002-07-04 and can be combined to densify the series. Composites are built from best-available observations within each 8-day window, so persistent cloud or snow still leaves gaps that must be handled explicitly before fitting seasonal curves.

current_task_binding.data_source: NASA LP DAAC at the USGS EROS Center, derived from Terra MODIS

observation_identity_contract.physical_object: vegetation leaf-area and absorbed photosynthetically active radiation
observation_identity_contract.source_lineage: Terra/Aqua MODIS MOD15/MYD15/MCD15 LAI-FPAR retrieval lineage
observation_identity_contract.non_material_variations: Terra/Aqua combination, collection version, grid, cadence, archive, resampling or aggregation retaining MODIS LAI/FPAR
observation_identity_contract.material_mismatches: NDVI/EVI, AVHRR LAI or another sensor/retrieval lineage without MODIS LAI/FPAR

original_anchor_asset.asset_alias_policy: MOD15A2H Collection 6/6.1 LAI or FPAR is admitted, as is the Aqua counterpart MYD15A2H on the same 8-day step and 500 m grid, since the two are routinely combined. MCD15A3H is excluded: it is the Terra+Aqua 4-day tier. The MOD13 vegetation-index tiers are excluded because they carry a different observable. AVHRR LAI3g and GIMMS NDVI are excluded.

repointed_from.reason: The source measures leaf area index, not a vegetation index. Its Methods open by naming Collection 6 MOD15A2H and MYD15A2H at 500 m on an 8-day step as the primary observable, quality-screened, averaged into 16-day composites, spatially aggregated to 0.05 degrees, then reduced to an annual mean. MOD13Q1 disagrees on all three counts: observable class, 250 m grid, and 16-day cadence.
repointed_from.why_this_is_a_repoint_not_a_substitution: MOD15A2H is published in the Earth Engine catalog at Collection 6.1 with status ready, covering 2000-02-18 to present. The exact product the source used is available, so no substitute is needed.
repointed_from.ndvi_role_in_source: GIMMS NDVI3gV1 appears in the source only as a training input to the neural network that generates the AVHRR LAI3gV1 comparison series. It is an intermediate, never an analysed observable, so it cannot justify a vegetation-index anchor.
repointed_from.collection_note: MODIS/006/MOD15A2H is deprecated and ends 2023-02-10; the anchor points at Collection 6.1.
